notes: Lavita is in Astana (Esil district, south-east, the Е111/Е826 street grid south of Улы Дала). Map-area method: the base box (±0.005 lat, ±0.008 lon around 51.071, 71.488) contains the krisha pins of the Lavita City apartment listings but has 0 commercial rent and 0 commercial sale listings - the complex is still being built and its ground-floor commercial is not on the market. Widened once (±0.010/±0.016): 11 rent and 14 sale, all marked scope=nearby. Almost all are in ЖК Багыстан / Bagystan-4 / New Line (ул. Е117 35-45, ~1-1.5 km north of Lavita at 51.080, 71.489; not a BI Group project), plus one Lumen (Е 453 24/1) and one мкр Комсомольский 40. Keyword searches (_txt_=Lavita, Лавита, Е 826) also return 0 commercial listings. All pages had a single page of results (no pagination). Printed ppm matched price/area on every row. Three sale rows are 2.7-4 m² storage units (кладовые: 1015933212, 1016062649, 1015847987) - exclude them from sale medians. Medians: rent (n=11, nearby) 4,615 ₸/m²/month (IQR approx 3,700-8,600; the 2,500 row is a warehouse); sale excl. storage (n=11, nearby) 637,363 ₸/m² (range 476,923-960,265); sale incl. storage (n=14) 576,697 ₸/m². Basement flags are false everywhere but are based only on the visible title/snippet (snippets truncated). Source conflicts: kn.kz describes 'LAVITA' as business class, 1-2 floors, II кв. 2026, while korter/krisha describe 'Lavita City' as comfort+, 9 floors, 1,746 apartments, III кв. 2026; same location, so treated as one bigville.
